name: book_appointment
description: Book the appointment. Call it ONLY after the person has explicitly confirmed the time, their name and their email read back to them. It takes the id of the chosen option, never a date or a time. Returns spokenConfirmation: read it exactly as it comes.

request_body_schema.description: The details the person confirmed, used to create the appointment.

optionId.description: The exact id of the option the person chose, as it came from check_availability: opt_1, opt_2 or opt_3. Never a date and never a time.

name.description: The person's full name, exactly as they dictated it.

email.description: The person's email address, lowercase and without spaces. For example: ana.perez@gmail.com
